en.title: Simultaneous Outages in ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok: Root Causes and Recovery Status
en.hook: Analyzing concurrent downtime across major AI services and infrastructure dependency risks
key_takeaways: Major LLM services including ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok experienced simultaneous large-scale outages.
Investigation focuses on shared network/CDN infrastructure dependencies or upstream service failures.
Highlights the urgent need for addressing Single Points of Failure (SPOF) in modern AI stacks.

zh.title: ChatGPT、Claude、Grok 几乎同时发生宕机：已知原因与恢复状态
zh.hook: 分析主要 AI 服务同时中断的原因以及底层基础设施依赖风险
key_takeaways: ChatGPT、Claude 和 Grok 等主流 LLM 服务在同一时间段内遭遇大规模服务中断。
原因调查指向共享的网络/CDN 基础设施故障或上游服务中断。
凸显了现代 AI 技术栈中消除单点故障 (SPOF) 并提升高可用性的重要性。
